name: canonical_fixed_6k1k_req128_qps1
decision: Step D17; parent-selected request count, QPS and warmup protocol

generator.formal_segments: one formal burst row at 0 s, followed by 127 formal steady rows at 1..127 s; zero warmup rows
generator.warmup_segments: 16 warmup rows at 0..15 s, generated separately

prompt_token_ids.scope: reuse this function only, not the driver's stage-admission run command or sampling settings
prompt_token_ids.rule: random.Random(request_id); length draws from range(100, vocab_size - 100)
prompt_token_ids.other_models: use each qualified model's own vocabulary size with the same request_id and length; GLM/V4 adoption and qualification remain pending

arrivals.rule: arrived_at[i] = i / qps seconds, i = 0..127, qps = 1.0
arrivals.seed_note: no arrival or length sampling; request-ID-derived prompt content is separate from arrival generation

lengths.counting_boundary: native engine prompt and generated-token counts; no text re-tokenization

formal.population: all 128 formal rows, including the first request; no first-request discard, warmup rows, sizing rows, or probes
formal.failed_or_short_requests: retain their records; a failure or output count other than 1024 does not permit dropping rows or claiming a complete formal result

warmup.arrival_rule: warmup_arrived_at[i] = i seconds, i = 0..15, on a separate timeline
warmup.measurement: excluded from every formal metric and from the formal trace
warmup.drain_before_formal: complete all warmup requests and verify both P/D roles have no waiting or running requests and KV cache usage is 0; only then start the formal timeline
warmup.repeat_identity: reuse exactly the same warmup IDs, lengths, arrivals, prompt-generation rule and sampling contract in every clean repetition

frontier_replay_contract.validation: verify all generated requests retain 6144/1024 tokens and arrival offsets 0..127; the default max_tokens=4096 would clip the prompt and must not be inherited

native_request_contract.prompt: pass prompt_token_ids(request_id, 6144, model_vocab_size) directly as the token-ID prompt
native_request_contract.first_token_evidence: record the first client-visible generated token, submission and completion on one client monotonic clock; native streaming behavior remains to be qualified
native_request_contract.length_validation: verify native accepted prompt count is 6144 and actual output count is 1024 for every warmup and formal request; do not add BOS/EOS or chat-template tokens

clean_repetitions.per_repeat: identical frozen formal and warmup inputs, IDs, lengths and arrival offsets; independent warmup/drain/formal windows with recorded boundaries
clean_repetitions.between_repeats: both roles idle with no running or waiting requests and KV cache usage back to 0
clean_repetitions.startup_limitation: a shared startup samples graph capture, kernel selection and placement only once per job

metric_contract.population: all 128 formal requests; warmup is always excluded
metric_contract.TTFT: per request: first client-visible token time minus client submission time; arithmetic mean over all formal requests; not internal prefill completion
metric_contract.E2E: per request: client completion time minus client submission time; arithmetic mean over all formal requests; not makespan
metric_contract.TPOT: per request: (E2E - TTFT) / (1024 - 1) = (E2E - TTFT) / 1023; arithmetic mean of the 128 per-request TPOT values
metric_contract.THPT: sum of formal prompt plus output tokens divided by the formal first-client-submission-to-last-client-completion window in seconds; for complete exact-length replay, 917504 / window_s tokens/s
metric_contract.formal_window: max(formal completion_monotonic) - min(formal submit_monotonic); excludes warmup and inter-phase idle periods, retains all elapsed time inside the formal window, and is not the 127-second arrival span
metric_contract.diagnostics: output-only throughput = 131072 / window_s tokens/s; request throughput = 128 / window_s requests/s; neither replaces gated THPT
metric_contract.latency_units: timestamp differences in seconds; report TTFT and E2E in ms and TPOT in ms/token with the matching factor of 1000
metric_contract.accuracy_gate: each of mean TTFT, mean TPOT, THPT and mean E2E independently requires abs(Frontier - native) / abs(native) <= 0.10; no measured values or passing verdicts are asserted here

regeneration.input_path_rule: use the exact repository-relative --workload arguments below; the generator records that argument in request_ids.json
regeneration.checksum_scope: workload.json, trace.csv, request_ids.json, warmup_workload.json, warmup/trace.csv, warmup/request_ids.json, manifest.json; SHA256SUMS does not hash itself

qualification.runtime: PENDING: native long-output completion, streaming measurements, warmup drain and clean-repeat integration have not been run for this package
qualification.glm_v4_adoption: PENDING: handoff required; the other session has not adopted these files
qualification.cross_task_formal_run: PENDING: do not start a formal cross-task workload run before both sessions reference the same frozen package
qualification.claims: workload artifact and CPU reproducibility evidence only; no GPU readiness, serving-capacity, performance or calibration claim
